messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected on /v1/stream in us-east-1 for model-raven-13B — p99 ~ 9.8s, p95 ~ 1.4s, streaming stalls increasing. auto-page events: 480/m  | affected shards: shard-17, shard-18

mia (oncall): seeing the same in grafana, tail really bad for streaming endpoints. clients report stalls at ~10s. paging to disk rate jumped.

aj (eng-sre): suspect KV slab fragmentation + prefill vs decode imbalance. recent prefill changes earlier today? @sam did we deploy anything that touches prefill budgets?

sam (infra): small tweak to prefill throttler rolled at 08:12, no model changes. rolling back now to test.

carla (site-reliability): customers A & B might hit SLOs — checking Slow Query logs and live sessions. Len pls escalate to CS if degradation confirmed.

mia (oncall): basic mitigation plan: 1) route streaming traffic off the most-impacted shards, 2) temporarily increase prefill cap for those shards to rebalance KV hotness, 3) disable aggressive decode prefetch if it's causing fragmentation. Thoughts?

aj (eng-sre): +1 for routing. disabling decode-prefetch may reduce memory churn — command for deploy:

```
# disable decode prefetch on shard pool
curl -X POST "https://control-plane/api/v1/shards/17/flags" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP' -d '{"decode_prefetch":false}'
```

sam (infra): started traffic reroute: using tag 'kv-relief' to move 20% of streaming sessions to standby pool (shard-24..26). watch psuedo-eviction counts.

deploy-bot: deploy started for control-plane/flags@release-2026-03-15-08:35 by sam — roll 3/6

mia (oncall): monitoring p99 now — initial change shows p99 drop to ~6.2s after reroute. still above SLO but trending down.

carla (site-reliability): customer impact: len, Customer A has 14 sessions stalled >10s, ticketing now. adding timeline for postmortem.

aj (eng-sre): we still see high page-in rates on shard-17; prefill cache hit% = 28% (target ~70%). Eviction rate spiking -> fragmentation. I recommend a targeted slab-reshuffle to compact KV. That needs a maintenance window ~2-3m per shard.

sam (infra): can we do slab-reshuffle via on-host tool with zero-downtime? There's a safe mode: compact-then-swap. Command: 

```
ssh ops@shard-17
sudo /opt/inference/kv-tools/compact --mode=shadow-swap --max-delta=200MB
```

Note: will load CPU for ~20s, but should not block decode path.

mia (oncall): agree to run on shard-17, schedule in 3m. aj pls own verification checks. I'll keep primary coordinator and update customers.

aj (eng-sre): running compact now on shard-17. tails: p99 pre-run 6.1s, p95 1.2s.

(1m later)

aj (eng-sre): compact finished on shard-17. observed reclaimed ~1.9GB fragmented slabs. p99 dropped to 3.4s, p95 stable at 0.9s. paging rate halved.

mia (oncall): nice. rolling compact to shard-18 next. sam, keep reroute until both compacts done.

sam (infra): reroute policy extended, standby pool handling ~25% now. no capacity errors.

carla (site-reliability): customer notes updated: partial mitigation in flight, CS pinged Customers A/B with ETA 15m. len, please add contact names.

len (customer-ops): pinged primary contacts, they appreciate the updates. watching for full recovery.

(2m later)

aj (eng-sre): compact done on shard-18. reclaimed ~2.4GB. p99 back near 1.1s, streaming stalls resolved on majority of sessions.

mia (oncall): returning traffic to normal routing. will keep elevated monitoring for 60m. setting alerting thresholds lower for next 24h.

sam (infra): rolled backed the prefill throttler tweak to previous values (was causing uneven prefetch bursts). change id: prefill-tweak-2026-03-15-0812 -> reverted.

carla (site-reliability): action items for post-incident: 1) add automated slab compaction trigger when fragmentation > 30% and page-in > threshold; 2) add prefill throttler canary tests for imbalance; 3) add a playbook entry for reroute + compact flow.

aj (eng-sre): also propose adding per-shard prefill budgets and a metric for decode vs prefill ratio to detect divergence earlier.

mia (oncall): agreed. I'll capture runbook and assign follow-ups. handing off to aj for next 2 hours — I'll be offline for on-call rotation. ack please.

aj (eng-sre): ack. monitoring and will escalate if p99 > 2s.

len (customer-ops): closing loop with customers, will reopen if they see renewed issues.

mia (oncall): summary for the thread: root cause = KV slab fragmentation + prefill vs decode imbalance after earlier throttler tweak -> increased paging -> streaming tail stalls -> p99 SLO breach. Immediate mitigations: reroute traffic, compact slabs (shadow-swap), revert prefill tweak. Next steps = runbook + metrics + automated compaction. Great teamwork, leaving notes in incident tracker. :thumbsup:
